s: Golden Barrel is the brand name of various sweeteners, dry mixes, and cooking oils of Good Food, Inc. since 1980. Good Food, Inc. is the food division of the Zook Molasses Company which was established in 1934 in Honey Brook, PA. Originally founded as a small division making table syrup and shoofly pie mixes in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, Good Food, Inc. has grown the Golden Barrel brand to include molasses, pancake syrup, coconut oil, sorghum syrup, shoofly cake mixes, and raw sugar as well as many others.
